name: Kasimir Asante-Petrov
location: The Narrows, near Fullerton and Damen

physical_description.build: Athletic, slightly soft at the middle from decades of club-sitting and Φ-backed meals. Broad shoulders, compact frame suggesting careful maintenance rather than active fitness.
physical_description.hair_color: Salt-and-pepper gray, natural with silver threading
physical_description.hair_style: Slicked back with pomade, precise side part
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint amber undertone
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm, even complexion with olive undertones from Slavic heritage
physical_description.complexion: Well-groomed, minimal scarring. Slight jowl softening at the jawline from age. Clean-shaven. Lines around eyes suggest chronic sleep deprivation and perpetual calculation.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar across left cheekbone, barely visible, suggesting old knife work or a close negotiation gone physical.
Faded tattoo of a playing card (Ace of Spades) on right inner wrist, barely visible under cuff unless forearm exposed.
Burn scar on right ring finger and pinkie, old and pale—cigarette or cards-table accident origin.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Moves with the practiced fluidity of someone carrying subcutaneous neural enhancements, likely decision-support or financial parsing implants, but nothing chrome-obvious.
physical_description.posture_movement: Centered weight, economical movement. Rarely gestures—when he does, it's precise and meaningful. Habitually makes eye contact. Tendency to tap fingers rhythmically when thinking, as if mentally shuffling a deck.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 independent: tailored charcoal suits from corporate-fringe tailors, silk shirts in muted colors (navy, cream, charcoal), Italian leather shoes kept obsessively polished. Omnipresent wrist accessories: vintage mechanical watch + discrete neural-link interface wrapped as a platinum bracelet. Overcoat in winter—wool blend, no logo. Jewelry minimal: gold wedding band (worn despite marital status unclear), one silver signet ring.

His posture is perfectly centered, commanding attention without moving. Subtle scar on left cheekbone. Wrist shows a platinum neural-interface bracelet and vintage watch.
